name: Is attic mold dangerous to my health?

mainEntity.name: Is attic mold dangerous to my health?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exposure to mold can cause health issues, especially for individuals with allergies, asthma, or compromised immune systems. Symptoms may include respiratory problems, skin irritation, headaches, and fatigue. While not all molds are toxic, prolonged exposure to any mold in an attic can degrade air quality throughout your home and potentially lead to adverse health effects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Attic mold can cause health issues like respiratory problems, allergies, and irritation, especially for sensitive individuals. It can degrade indoor air quality.
